catalog.note: A calcite cobble whose natural shape was worked to show two figures in coitus: heads, arms and legs stand out where the surface was picked away, and the figures have no faces. About 11,000 years old, it is thought to be the oldest known representation of a couple making love. Shown under the British Museum’s non-commercial share-alike licence.
